comment: Shared classification table for Discord auto-thread creation errors. internal/autothread Go tests, the cmd/autothread CLI tests, and the Python bridge test (tests/gateway/test_discord_auto_thread_adopt.py) all consume these cases: Classify must answer the stated decision for the (status, code, message) triple, and the Python bridge must return the same decision through the real binary. The adapter acts on "adopt" only; rate_limited/retry/fail all fall through to the historical retry-and-seed-fallback path, so the table must never move an existing non-adopt row to adopt.

cases.name: 160004 with status and canonical text
cases.message: A thread has already been created for this message (error code: 160004)

cases.name: duck-typed error that lost the code still adopts via text
cases.message: A thread has already been created for this message
